coverage.notes: Row types: (1) unit totals for all hunts combined (method 'all', no hunt) from each year's Big Game Annual Report, 2020-2024; (2) one row per hunt code (hunt set) from UDWR's limited-entry/OIAL, antlerless and general-season harvest reports, 2020-2024, and from the 2025 preliminary harvest report; (3) one 'Statewide' row per year from the statewide statistics table of the 2024 Big Game Annual Report. Do not add hunt rows to unit totals - the unit totals already include every hunt. Hunt-row unit ids come from the same year's Big Game Annual Report hunt tables; for 2025 they come from the 2024 report when the hunt code and hunt name match, otherwise unit is the hunt name (see row note). daysHunted is UDWR's mean days hunted per hunter. UDWR computes success rates from raw survey data, so they can differ from harvest/hunters; rates are shown as published. Hunts the agency printed as 'No data' are omitted; the 2023-2024 LE/OIAL reports do not list statewide sportsman/conservation permits for deer, elk or pronghorn (those permits appear in the unit-total table as 'Statewide Sportsman/Conservation'). 2025 numbers are preliminary; the 2025 Big Game Annual Report (unit totals) was not published as of 2026-10-31. Also included for 2020-2024: general-season elk harvest by unit for each season/weapon table (archery, extended archery, spike and any-bull rifle/any legal weapon, muzzleloader, youth, multiseason); 2020 tables are by unit/subunit (unit id = unit + subunit letter). Multiseason tables publish hunters only by weapon, so hunters is null and the weapon counts are in the note. Sum of unit totals vs statewide total: 2020 13,600 vs 13,600; 2021 14,611 vs 14,601; 2022 15,421 vs 15,447; 2023 13,368 vs 13,376; 2024 14,495 vs 14,494 (agency rounding of projected estimates).

2020-2024: hunter harvest by unit from the appendix of the 2024 Black Bear Annual Report (unit ids as printed there, e.g. '10ab', '25c/26'); 2025: Table 3 of the 2025 report, which lists units by name only (UDWR stopped publishing unit codes and per-unit history tables in 2025), so 2025 unit ids are the published names. Statewide rows: 2020-2024 from Table 2 and 2025 from Table 3 of the 2025 report. UDWR does not publish hunters afield for bear, so hunters and successPct are null; licenses = permits issued (2020-2024) or permits & quota (2025); percent of permits filled is in the note. Harvest excludes depredation/other mortality. 2025 unit rows sum to the published statewide total (479).

Desert bighorn (DS hunts) and Rocky Mountain bighorn (RS/RE hunts, including ewe hunts) are combined in this file; statewide rows are given separately for each subspecies (see methodLabel). UDWR publishes no unit-total table for sheep, only hunt rows. Conservation-permit hunts and statewide sportsman/conservation permits that the separate LE/OIAL report omits were added from the same year's Big Game Annual Report hunt tables (row note says so); where the two reports print the same hunt under different codes (2020-21 RS6719/RS6725 Nebo) only the LE-report row is kept. With that, hunt rows sum exactly to the statewide desert + Rocky Mountain harvest every year 2020-2024 (159, 145, 143, 142, 144).

2020-2024: hunter harvest by unit from the appendix of the 2024 Cougar Annual Report (unit ids as printed, e.g. '22b', '10b/11c'); 2025: Table 3 of the 2025 report (units by name only; UDWR stopped publishing unit codes and per-unit tables). Statewide rows 2020-2025 from Tables 2-3 of the 2025 report. Superscript footnotes (cougars of unknown sex) were read separately from the PDF so they are not merged into the totals. Most units have been unlimited harvest-objective since 2021 (the 2024 report appendix lists 'Unlimited' for most units from 2021), so licenses is null there and UDWR does not publish hunters afield (hunters and successPct null). 2025 unit rows sum to the published statewide total (381).

From UDWR Upland Game Annual Reports 2019-20 through 2025-26. Spring seasons 2020-2026 and fall management seasons 2020-2025. Rows: spring limited-entry/CWMU by hunt (TK codes, unit = region/CWMU); spring general season by county of harvest (2020-2025, with regional and statewide totals); fall management hunts by region and hunt area (2020-2024) and by hunt (2025); statewide summary rows from the 2024-25 report's statewide tables. The spring general-season statewide figure appears twice with different values because UDWR publishes two tables (county table total vs statewide summary table); both are labelled. Spring 2026 is included only at hunt level (Table 31 of the 2025-26 report); the 2026 county tables were not used. Turkey success = percent of hunters who harvested, as published.
Utah has no white-tailed deer hunting season; UDWR publishes no whitetail harvest.
